chunks.text: Before servicing the pump motor, apply lockout tagout to the main isolator. WARNING: Verify the zero energy state with a calibrated voltmeter before touching any conductor. Do not rely on the indicator light.
Before servicing the pump motor, apply lockout tagout to the main isolator. Verify the zero energy state by checking that the indicator light is off before touching any conductor.
Tighten the impeller bolts of pump P-110 to 45 N*m in a star pattern. This torque value applies to impeller part number 7740-221-B.
Error E-4471 indicates low suction pressure. Check the inlet valve and clean the strainer before restarting the pump.
The shaft diameter must be 25.00 mm with a tolerance of 0.02 mm. Measure the shaft at three points along its length.
Gearbox GB-300 requires lubricant grade ISO VG 46. Replace the lubricant every 2000 hours of operation.
When handling solvent SOL-12, wear nitrile gloves and splash goggles. WARNING: Never mix SOL-12 with oxidizers.
